secrets.name: RAZEN_MCP_TOKEN
secrets.description: Bearer token for the /api/mcp endpoint. Optional for dev — MCP auth is skipped when unset.

secrets.name: VERCEL_TOKEN
secrets.description: Vercel deploy token used by the /api/ship CD endpoint. Optional for dev.

secrets.name: SHIP_SECRET
secrets.description: Shared secret for the /api/ship deployment webhook. Optional for dev.

secrets.name: TMN_KEY_ID
secrets.description: TrueMoney/TMNOne API key ID. Optional — app runs in sim mode without it.

secrets.name: TMN_MSISDN
secrets.description: TrueMoney account phone number. Optional — sim mode without it.

secrets.name: TMN_LOGIN_TOKEN
secrets.description: TrueMoney login token. Optional — sim mode without it.

secrets.name: TMN_ID
secrets.description: TrueMoney account ID. Optional — sim mode without it.

secrets.name: TMN_DEVICE_ID
secrets.description: TrueMoney device ID. Optional — sim mode without it.

secrets.name: TMN_PIN
secrets.description: TrueMoney PIN. Optional — sim mode without it.
